note: 24,000 arm64 minutes a month on ubuntu-24.04-arm is $120 at the arm rate; Ubicloud's arm runner would be $30 and a connected machine $24 flat, so the machine wins by $96. The job ran on GitHub's arm64 runner, so it reads BUILDHOUND_LINUX_ARM64, never the any-Linux variable: an x86-64 host must not take a native arm64 build.
